definitions.gloss: tidying up, cleaning up, putting away
definitions.explanation: The act of organizing and putting things in order.
Completing or settling a matter or task.

notes:
{片付|かたづ}け is the noun form of ⟦{片付|かたづ}ける→片付ける：01192_katazukeru⟧ (to tidy up).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {片付|かたづ}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to do tidying up)
- {片付|かたづ}け⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧/⟦{苦手|にがて}→苦手：03513_nigate⟧ (good/bad at tidying)
- {片付|かたづ}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{手伝|てつだ}う→手伝う：00898_tetsudau⟧ (to help tidy up)
